entry_mode_text: Market at the daily-open anchor (07:00 UK = 09:00 broker); fill level is the D-1 reference close 7436.80.
management_text: Three equal units. Unit 1 exits at TP1 7530.09 (+1R). Unit 2 exits at TP2 7623.38 (+2R); on that fill Unit 3 stop moves to entry +0.2R = 7455.46. Unit 3 is time-stopped at the session close or price-stopped at entry +3xATR14 = 7662.34, whichever triggers first. Wide-stop flag set: R 93.29 pts = 1.24 x ATR14 (cash) - size reduced accordingly. Thesis invalidation (separate from the stop): a daily close back through D-1 daily S1 7385.07. Holding period collides with the scheduled Nvidia Q1 earnings event - event risk live.
rationale: REFERENCE CLOSE: 7436.80, the settled cash-session close of Wed 20 May 2026 - the last completed US500 session strictly before D = 2026-05-21 (slice cash window 16:30-23:00 broker = 09:30-16:00 ET). The report's own price table prints 7432.97 for this close; the slice value 7436.80 is used instead (Delta -3.83 report-vs-slice, a consistent CFD-vs-cash basis offset flagged by the QA reconciliation log), because levels must be slice-derived. ANCHOR: 09:00 broker = 07:00 UK, the standard daily-open anchor. The report's own agent log argues for an operator override to a 00:00 UK / 02:00 broker 'anchored-open proxy'; that override is not adopted because the construction rules make the anchor a fixed instance value that may not be re-selected at run time and make the order-side/anchor rules non-overridable by any run-time or operator instruction. A market entry at the 09:00 anchor still fills at the D-1 reference close per the reference-close rule, so the entry level is unaffected. ATR14 = 75.18 pts, 14 sessions ending at D-1, computed on cash-session (16:30-23:00 broker) bars from the slice; the full-day-bar ATR14 on the same slice is 82.07 pts (this is the basis the linter uses for its ratio flags). The report's implied ATR of approx 59.84 pts is rejected as a non-reproducing figure. 0.25 x ATR14 = 18.80 pts; 3.0 x ATR14 = 225.54 pts. DIRECTION: LONG. The report's own direction score is +0.30 against a conviction threshold of 0.25, so the conviction gate does not fire and Trade 1 is not suppressed. ENTRY 7436.80 = MARKET at the reference close (order-side rule: a market card enters at the reference close exactly). STOP 7343.51: the rule is the tighter of (5-day swing extreme + 0.25 x ATR14) and (nearest 5-day-structure support + 0.25 x ATR14). Route (a) 5-day swing low = 7339.10, printed on the 2026-05-19 cash session, less 18.80 = 7320.31 (R 116.49). Route (b) nearest support in the 5-day OHLC structure below the reference close = 7362.30, which is simultaneously the 2026-05-19 cash close and the 2026-05-20 cash session low (a double touch), less 18.80 = 7343.51 (R 93.29). Route (b) is the tighter anchor and is therefore the one the rule selects. The 3.5 x ATR14 structural cap (263.13 pts) is not binding. R = 7436.80 - 7343.51 = 93.29 pts = 1.24 x ATR14 (cash) / 1.14 x ATR14 (full-day) - inside the mandatory 0.3-3.0 x ATR14 band on both bases, but above 1.00 x ATR14, so the wide-stop flag is set by arithmetic. TP1 = entry + 1R = 7530.09 (93.29 pts from entry, inside the 2.5 x ATR14 limit of 187.95 cash / 205.18 full-day). TP2 = entry + 2R = 7623.38. TP3 = the Unit-3 price cap at entry + 3.0 x ATR14 = 7436.80 + 225.54 = 7662.34, which sits above TP2 - the ladder inversion the QA feedback found in the original card (cap 7612.49 below TP2 7646.43) was caused solely by the understated ATR and disappears once the slice ATR14 is used. No fib retracement level is used on this card: the fib swing anchor is a Trade 3A/3B input only. Daily pivots cited for the invalidation are computed from the D-1 (2026-05-20) cash session H/L/C 7443.0 / 7362.3 / 7436.8 by P = (H+L+C)/3 = 7414.03, S1 = 2P - H = 7385.07; the report's pivot table is built from the 2026-05-19 session (one session stale) and is not used. Invalidation 7385.07 sits 41.56 pts from the stop, more than 0.15 x ATR14 (11.28), so it carries information the stop does not. Linter: CLEAN, no DUD, no WARN.

entry_mode_text: Buy stop at 7468.67, resting from the 09:00 broker anchor; +31.87 pts above the D-1 reference close 7436.80.
management_text: Three equal units. Unit 1 exits at TP1 7480.25 (daily R1.5), Unit 2 at TP2 7494.73 (daily R2); on the Unit 2 fill the Unit 3 stop moves to entry +0.2R = 7477.53. Unit 3 traces toward TP3 7546.47 (daily R3). R 44.29 pts = 0.59 x ATR14 (cash) - no wide-stop flag. Breakout-side-only construction: in the TRANSITION regime the counter-side limit is suppressed, not re-labelled. Thesis invalidation (separate from the stop): a daily close back through the broken boundary, daily R1 7465.77. Holding period collides with the scheduled Nvidia Q1 earnings event. The monthly pivot tier is single-source-indicative and is not used on this card; the daily tier used here is computed from corroborated D-1 cash H/L/C.
rationale: REFERENCE CLOSE: 7436.80, cash-session close of Wed 20 May 2026 (last completed session strictly before D). ANCHOR 09:00 broker = 07:00 UK, as for Trade 1 and for the same reason. ATR14 = 75.18 pts (14 sessions to D-1, cash-session bars from the slice; 82.07 pts on full-day bars). REGIME/BRANCH: the report calls the consolidated regime TRANSITION (short-term Transitional over a medium-term Trending-Bullish structure, KER +0.27), so the pivot trade takes the TRANSITION branch - breakout side only, aligned with the upside break watched by the Trade 3 variant. PIVOTS: daily floor pivots from the D-1 (2026-05-20) cash session H = 7443.0, L = 7362.3, C = 7436.8, by P = (H+L+C)/3 = 7414.03; R1 = 2P - L = 7465.77; R2 = P + (H-L) = 7494.73; R3 = H + 2(P-L) = 7546.47; S1 = 2P - H = 7385.07. R1.5 = (R1+R2)/2 = 7480.25 (the only midpoint the rules permit to be derived). The report's daily pivot table is built from the 2026-05-19 session - one session stale - and is discarded; its weekly table uses the 15 May low as the week low instead of the week's true low, and is also discarded. ENTRY 7468.67: the branch's breakout entry is 'ten per cent of the way from the anchor pivot to the next pivot above it'. Applied literally to P it gives 7414.03 + 0.10 x (7465.77 - 7414.03) = 7419.20, which sits BELOW the reference close 7436.80 - a buy stop there is on the wrong side of the close and the order-side rule requires the card be rebuilt rather than shipped with a note (the weekly tier fails the same test: 7428.07 + 0.10 x 82.76 = 7436.35, still 0.45 pts below the close). The rebuild shifts the pivot anchor up one tier to the first daily pivot standing above the reference close, R1 = 7465.77 - which is the boundary the breakout must actually clear - and applies the branch's own two formulas around that anchor: entry = R1 + 0.10 x (R2 - R1) = 7465.77 + 2.90 = 7468.67, signed gap to the reference close +31.87 pts (correct side for a buy stop). STOP 7424.38 = R1 - 0.8 x (R1 - P) = 7465.77 - 41.39, the branch's 'anchor pivot less eighty per cent of the distance to the level below' with the same shifted anchor. R = 7468.67 - 7424.38 = 44.29 pts = 0.59 x ATR14 (cash) / 0.54 x ATR14 (full-day) - inside the mandatory 0.3-3.0 x ATR14 band on both bases. TARGETS are the next defined pivot levels above the entry, so the ladder cannot invert: TP1 = daily R1.5 7480.25 (+11.58 pts, well inside the 2.5 x ATR14 limit), TP2 = daily R2 7494.73 (+26.06), TP3 = daily R3 7546.47 (+77.80). No swing anchor and no fib retracement enters this card - it is pivot-derived end to end. Invalidation: a daily close back through the broken boundary R1 7465.77, which is 41.39 pts from the stop, more than 0.15 x ATR14 (11.28). The branch's nominal 'close back through P' invalidation could not be used: P 7414.03 sits only 10.35 pts from the stop, inside the 0.15 x ATR14 exclusion. Linter: CLEAN, no DUD, no WARN.

entry_mode_text: SUPPRESSED - no confirmed break at the D-1 close, so no order is placed and no entry level is issued.
management_text: SUPPRESSED - no confirmed break of the 25-session range at the D-1 close. No entry, stop, R or target ladder is issued. Commentary only (outside the card): the trade would arm on a daily close at or above 7541.70 (25-session high 7522.90 + 0.25 x ATR14 18.80); the D-1 close 7436.80 is 104.90 pts below that condition.
rationale: REFERENCE CLOSE: 7436.80, cash-session close of Wed 20 May 2026 (last completed session strictly before D = 2026-05-21). ATR14 = 75.18 pts (14 sessions to D-1, cash-session bars from the slice; 82.07 pts on full-day bars). VARIANT SELECTION: the report calls the consolidated regime TRANSITION, and the fixed regime-to-variant mapping sends TRANSITION to variant 3C (Momentum-Breakout). No discretion is exercised and no other variant is substituted. RANGE: the 25-session range is defined on the swing high and swing low of the medium-term block, taken from the slice cash sessions - high 7522.90 printed 2026-05-14, low 7012.10 printed 2026-04-16, width 510.80 pts, midpoint 7267.50. The report instead defines the boundary on the 14 May CLOSE (7500.85) while its own narrative gives the 14 May high as 7515.62; both are rejected in favour of the slice high/low definition the rules require. CONFIRMED BREAK TEST: a confirmed break requires a daily close beyond the boundary by at least 0.25 x ATR14 = 18.80 pts, i.e. a close at or above 7522.90 + 18.80 = 7541.70 for the upside break. The D-1 close is 7436.80, which is 104.90 pts short. The break is therefore NOT confirmed and the suppression trigger 'no confirmed break in the TRANSITION regime' fires. SUPPRESSED accordingly: this is a non-discretionary gate, and a suppressed card is a row and not a card - it carries no entry, stop, R or target ladder, so every level field is null. The report reached the same eligibility conclusion ('not yet eligible: the 20 May close is below the trigger') and its own five-session reconstruction shows this variant suppressed in all five prior sessions, but it then emitted a full ladder anyway; that ladder is not reproduced here. Two independent reasons confirm suppression is the only compliant output: the mechanical stop (range low + 0.40 x width = 7012.10 + 204.32 = 7216.42) would put R at roughly 325 pts = 4.3 x ATR14, outside the mandatory 0.3-3.0 x ATR14 band, and the mechanical TP1 (measured move = 7522.90 + 510.80 = 8033.70) would sit about 6.5 x ATR14 from any plausible trigger, outside the 2.5 x ATR14 target limit - so no in-bounds card can be built from the variant's own geometry at this range width. The break side is recorded as LONG (recent failed retests sit at the upper boundary, and the medium-term structure and cross-asset read are constructive) purely so the watch has a direction; no fib retracement is involved, since this variant is anchored to the 25-session range rather than to a fib swing. Direction is unaffected by the report's +0.30 conviction score, which governs Trade 1 only. Linter: SUPPRESSED row, no DUD, no WARN.
